messages.content: Implement Python `strip_prefix(text, prefix)` that removes prefix once when present and otherwise returns text unchanged. Empty prefix leaves text unchanged.

def strip_prefix(text: str, prefix: str) -> str:
    return text[len(prefix):] if text.startswith(prefix) else text
Implement TypeScript `last<T>(items: readonly T[]): T | undefined` without mutating items.
Implement Python `clamp_zero(value)` returning zero for negative integers and the value otherwise.

def clamp_zero(value: int) -> int:
    return max(0, value)

Implement Python parse_ratio(text: str) -> tuple[int, int]. Accept exactly two nonnegative ASCII decimal integers separated by one colon, with no whitespace; reject a zero denominator and malformed input with ValueError.

Implement Python transpose(rows) for a sequence of equal-length sequences. Return a list of tuples representing columns. Return [] for no rows and raise ValueError for ragged rows. Do not mutate rows.
Implement Python min_max(items) for a one-shot iterable of comparable values. Return (minimum, maximum) using one pass, and raise ValueError for empty input.

Fix Python def safe_lookup(values, index): return values[index] if index < len(values) else None so negative indices do not access from the end. Return None for any out-of-range index; preserve the signature.
Implement Python middle(text: str) -> str. Return the middle character for odd length or two middle characters for even length; empty input returns empty string. Use Python string indexing semantics.

def middle(text: str) -> str:
    start = (len(text) - 1) // 2
    end = len(text) // 2 + 1
    return text[start:end] if text else ""
Implement TypeScript compact<T>(items: readonly (T | null | undefined)[]): T[]. Remove only null and undefined, preserving false, zero, empty string, and input order.
Implement JavaScript repeatText(text, count). Return text repeated count times; require a nonnegative safe integer count and throw RangeError otherwise.
Implement TypeScript isOneOf<T extends string>(value: string, allowed: readonly T[]): value is T. Use exact case-sensitive equality and leave allowed unchanged.
Implement JavaScript clampNumber(value, low, high). Require all three to be finite numbers and low <= high; throw RangeError otherwise. Return value confined to the inclusive bounds.

Implement Java static String maskTail(String text, int visible). Replace all but the final visible UTF-16 code units with '*'. Reject negative visible with IllegalArgumentException; if visible exceeds the length, return text unchanged.
Implement Java static int[] reversedCopy(int[] values). Return a new array in reverse order without modifying values.

Write pytest tests for parse_percentage(text: str) -> int. It accepts exactly an ASCII integer from 0 to 100 followed by %, with no whitespace; raises ValueError otherwise. Cover boundaries and malformed inputs. Do not implement the function.
